artists.biography: Tim Bowness is a british singer/songwriter primarily known for his work as part of the band No-Man, a long-term project with Steven Wilson from Porcupine Tree.  In addition to producing several albums with No-Man, Tim has recorded with popular Italian artist Alice, experimental guitar legend David Torn, Soft Machine's Hugh Hopper, Roger Eno, German band Centrozoon, and recorded the album Flame (1994) in collaboration with Porcupine Tree/ex-Japan keyboard player Richard Barbieri.  Tim's debut solo album, My Hotel Year, was released on the One Little Indian label in 2004.

Tim Bowness.biography: Tim Bowness is a british singer/songwriter primarily known for his work as part of the band No-Man, a long-term project with Steven Wilson from Porcupine Tree.  In addition to producing several albums with No-Man, Tim has recorded with popular Italian artist Alice, experimental guitar legend David Torn, Soft Machine's Hugh Hopper, Roger Eno, German band Centrozoon, and recorded the album Flame (1994) in collaboration with Porcupine Tree/ex-Japan keyboard player Richard Barbieri.  Tim's debut solo album, My Hotel Year, was released on the One Little Indian label in 2004.

perplexity.description:
Powder Dry is the eighth studio album by British rock artist Tim Bowness, released in 2024 on the Kscope label. Marking his first release with the label, the album stands out as a fully solo endeavor, with Bowness writing, producing, and performing all instruments and vocals. The record features sixteen tracks in just over forty minutes, showcasing a shift toward shorter, more concise songs compared to his previous work. Musically, Powder Dry blends an 80s synth aesthetic with influences from late 70s David Bowie, post-punk, and occasional industrial touches, resulting in a dynamic and varied soundscape that reflects Bowness’s evolving style.

Within his discography, Powder Dry represents a significant step as Bowness’s most personal and self-contained project to date. The album’s concise songwriting and stylistic experimentation signal a departure from the more expansive arrangements of earlier releases like Late Night Laments (2020) and Butterfly Mind (2022). Mixing in both stereo and surround was handled by Steven Wilson, further enhancing the album’s immersive quality. Critics have noted the album’s adventurous spirit and its successful integration of diverse influences, with positive reviews highlighting its emotional depth and sonic innovation. As Bowness’s debut on Kscope, Powder Dry has been well-received for its bold artistic direction and its contribution to the label’s reputation for progressive and boundary-pushing rock music.
